$comment: ParallelFlow App Tools — MCP server exposed BY the app TO the agent runtime. Contract v0.1.0. Transport: MCP Streamable HTTP at ToolToken.mcp_url; auth: Bearer ToolToken. Every call is authorised against the token's session_key/project_id and the on_behalf_of user's capabilities, logged to app_tool_calls, and returns MCP errors with codes SCOPE_MISMATCH | FORBIDDEN | NOT_FOUND | APPROVAL_REQUIRED | RATE_LIMITED.
human_only_actions_not_exposed: push to Arena without user confirmation

tools.name: arena.read_history
tools.description: Read Arena messages of the token's project (paged, newest first). Authors are given by name and type only (no ids); each message has `at` (for the `before` cursor) and `when` in plain words.

x-parallelflow.scope: project from token only; any id outside token.project_id → SCOPE_MISMATCH

tools.name: artifacts.list
tools.description: List project artifacts (optionally by cycle/stage/kind). Each item also says, in plain words, who wrote the latest version (latest_written_by: a person, "AI" or "AI for <person>"), how it got there (latest_how, e.g. "Pushed from Private v3 by Asha"), who approved the approved version (approved_by) and when it last changed (last_updated).

tools.name: ask.question
tools.description: Ask the person who asked you a multiple-choice question, when their request is ambiguous or a choice would materially change the result. Give 2-5 short, distinct options; set allow_other to let them type their own answer. The question is shown to them as a card; after calling this, stop and wait. Their answer arrives as their next message. Do not ask what you can find out with your other tools.

x-parallelflow.scope: asks only the person whose message started the turn; delivered as the RIC question.asked event
